strengths: PRD requirements, acceptance criteria, and task artifact tasks share stable IDs.
Task artifacts are vertical slices with task-level verification commands.
risks: Human approval is still required after the grill phase before implementation begins.
Spec-Kit MCP availability is environment-dependent; local artifacts are the fallback.
recommendations: Review HITL task artifacts before executing implementation tasks.
Run Spec-Kit analyze/checklist tools when MCP is available to compare against local validation.
Create the Spec-Kit archive after eval so the shared handoff contains the latest score.
